scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=@forge-org/tokens && npm run build --workspace=@forge-org/icons && npm run build --workspace=@forge-org/ui
scripts.test: npm run build && npm test --workspace=@forge-org/tokens && npm test --workspace=@forge-org/icons && npm test --workspace=@forge-org/ui
scripts.quality: npm run test && npm run pack:check
scripts.pack:check: npm pack --workspace=@forge-org/tokens --dry-run && npm pack --workspace=@forge-org/icons --dry-run && npm pack --workspace=@forge-org/ui --dry-run
